thread:
olivia_cs: FYI customer ACME (ingest team) says their downstream parser started failing after the model flip this morning. They say JSON schema used to validate but now `items` is coming back as a single string and `order_id` looks encoded. Repro steps + sample below, can ENG take a look?

sam_support: Can you paste the raw request + failing response please? Also is this canary or full rollout?

olivia_cs: Repro (from ACME):
```bash
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate \\  -H 'Authorization: Bearer $KEY' \\  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \\  -d '{"model":"rwd-infer-v2-quant","prompt":"extract order info","output_format":"json_schema","schema":{"type":"object","properties":{"order_id":{"type":"integer"},"items":{"type":"array","items":{"type":"object","properties":{"sku":{"type":"string"},"qty":{"type":"integer"}}}}}}'}
```
Failing response (from ACME ingest logs):
```json
{"order_id":"aWQ6MTIzNDU=","items":"[{\"sku\":\"X-123\",\"qty\":2},{\"sku\":\"Y-456\",\"qty\":1}]","total":39.5}
```
They say their JSON validator chokes because `items` is a string not an array and `order_id` is a base64-like string. This started right after the model swap at ~09:12 PT.

deploy-bot: Deployment rwd-infer-v2-quant rolled out to prod at 2025-11-12T09:12:08Z (canary -> 100% completed).

jordan_eng: Thanks — can you confirm request `output_format` and whether `structured_output` / function-calling flags were used? Also need a request_id and trace from ACME for one failing request.

olivia_cs: They used `output_format: json_schema` (no function-calls). ACME provided request_id `req_0a9f3e` and trace id `trace-6791`. They replayed identical prompt to staging in our support account and reproduced. Occurrence ~ 7/80 requests.

maria_eng-ml: Hm. Two quick hypotheses: 1) model variant started to emit top-level JSON as a stringified block (we've seen tokenization so model outputs a JSON string) 2) post-processing code that tries to coerce types misfired with quantized tokens (eg numeric tokens escaped). Can you dump the raw text output (not the parsed JSON) from the same request?

jordan_eng: Also check whether the `schema` enforcement step (our parser that casts types) logged any warnings. If the model returned a stringified JSON blob we may be double-parsing incorrectly and turning arrays into strings. I'll ask SRE to grab the raw llm_output for `trace-6791`.

olivia_cs: Raw LLM text (from ACME trace):
```
{"order_id":"id:12345","items":[{"sku":"X-123","qty":2},{"sku":"Y-456","qty":1}],"total":39.5}
```
But the API response shown to customer had `order_id` as `aWQ6MTIzNDU=` and `items` stringified. They say our API layer returned a different serialized form.

sam_support: Customer is blocked — their ingestion pipeline rejects anything that isn't strict schema. They're throttling traffic until this is fixed. Billing impact reported. Priority: P0 for CS.

jordan_eng: Starting investigation. @maria_eng-ml @maria_eng-ml can you look at the output sanitization step? Might be a double-encoding path when `output_format=json_schema` + quantized model variant. I'll open an internal ticket.

maria_eng-ml: On it. Quick mitigation: recommend rolling back `rwd-infer-v2-quant` to previous stable model `rwd-infer-v1.9` for customers hitting strict parsers. Also suggest a temporary toggle `strict_schema: true` to force parser to reject string blobs and return 422 rather than silently coercing.

jordan_eng: Created ENG ticket INF-3458 and linked trace/req. I'm going to initiate a canary rollback for the region.

deploy-bot: Rollback job INF-3458: reverting to rwd-infer-v1.9 started at 2025-11-12T10:02:12Z. Rollback to 100% completed at 2025-11-12T10:05:47Z.

olivia_cs: ACME confirms after rollback they saw correct typed JSON responses for the same test requests. Partial fix confirmed by customer, they will resume ingest and monitor. They want a postmortem and definitive root cause before reflip.

jordan_eng: Noted, we'll keep ACME pinned to v1.9 until root cause triaged. ACTIONS: ENG to add more unit tests around `json_schema` path, ML to investigate token-level output that can cause stringification, SRE to add trace capture when schema parsing fails.

olivia_cs: Thanks team — please DM me updates. ACME appreciates the quick rollback. :heart:

sam_support: Adding customer to incident notification list and scheduling wrap-up call with ACME next week.
